news.title: Acclaimed Stevie's Famous Pizza Celebrates Grand Opening on Phinney Ridge
Urban Family Brewing opening Seattle waterfront restaurant this summer
Restaurant Roundup: Praise-Worthy Pizza and Aperitivo Hour

candidates.name: Stevie's Famous
candidates.note: Third location (first north of downtown, and its largest) opened Aug 2, 2026 with strong regional press; not yet in the dataset.

candidates.name: Urban Family Brewing (Waterfront)
candidates.note: Ballard brewery's new waterfront outpost, opening late Aug/early Sept 2026, built around grandma-style pizza rather than beer alone.

candidates.name: Abecedary
candidates.note: Pizzaiolo Seth Eisner's forthcoming New Haven-style pizzeria/brewery gave a sneak-peek pop-up at the Hillman City Block Party ahead of its planned 2027 opening.
